title: Implementation Manager
description:
About the job


Sphere Pay is looking for a full-time Implementation Manager based in Miami or Brazil. As an Implementation Manager at Sphere Pay, you will be the critical bridge between our sales/GTM team and our product organization, ensuring customers can successfully integrate and leverage our API-first payment infrastructure. The work you do directly supports our customers' ability to move money with us; you will regularly have an outsized impact on Sphere Pay's customer success and product evolution.

Key Responsibilities:


Technical Discovery & Solution Design: Partner with the Head of BD on discovery calls to gather customer technical requirements. Assess requirements against our current capabilities, architect tailored solutions, and clearly communicate any gaps to our product team. You will translate complex customer needs into actionable product feedback.


Integration Lifecycle Management: Own the full integration lifecycle from initial discovery call through final go-live. This includes creating development guides, providing hands-on support during implementation, and ensuring customers have a clear path to successful integration with our API.


Customer Technical Support: Handle integration requests from the sales team post-discovery. Guide external developers on how to integrate our API, explaining not just the how but the why behind integration decisions.


Product Feedback Loop: Serve as the voice of the customer to our product team. Translate specific customer requests into product requirements and advocate for features that will improve the customer experience and expand our capabilities.


Customer Relationship Management (CRM): Build long-term partnerships with clients acting as the primary point of contact for technical inquiries and strategic planning. Track, report, and update necessary internal systems related to client implementations.


Qualifications:


  • Fluency in English, Portuguese Required - Spanish business level fluency is nice to have
  • 3+ years of experience in sales engineering, solutions architecture, or API Implementation
  • Strong technical background with hands-on experience working with APIs and guiding developers through integrations.
  • Proven experience writing technical documentation, API docs, and integration guides.
  • Experience within payments and/or fintech required.
  • Crypto/Web3 is a plus but not required.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Self-starter comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Fully Remote - Based in Miami or Brazil (preferred).


Sphere Pay is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds and experiences to apply.

Sphere Pay is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workforce. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

title: Automotive Project/Release Manager
description:
Project Description:

This role coordinates delivery and releases for an in-car accessibility product within an Android-based infotainment system, with a primary focus on meeting legal and regulatory accessibility requirements.


Core responsibilities include ensuring compliance, traceability, and correct implementation of accessibility-related changes, while driving quality improvements, defect resolution, and predictable, disciplined releases. Occasional support for new feature development is also expected.

Due to the nature of accessibility work, even small changes can have significant user and legal impact, making precision, validation, and strong execution essential. The role operates in a highly complex stakeholder environment, where stakeholders are typically hands-off during day-to-day execution but become highly involved and escalatory when issues arise. Successfully navigating these situations—through transparency, risk anticipation, sound judgment, and resolution under pressure—is a critical aspect of the role.

The role works closely with a small team of Android developers. The exact split of responsibilities will be defined once the new hire is onboarded, allowing flexibility based on individual strengths, experience, and evolving product and delivery needs.


Responsibilities:

Product & Backlog Management

• Manage and maintain the product backlog in Jira, with a primary focus on accessibility-related bug

fixes, improvements, and release work

• Support new accessibility features by preparing, refining, and tracking requirements and acceptance

criteria with stakeholder

• Clarify functional, UX, and accessibility requirements with stakeholders and engineering

• Ensure backlog items are well-defined, testable, and ready for implementation


Sprint, PI & Delivery Execution

• Plan and facilitate sprint and PI activities with the development team

• Coordinate sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and execution tracking

• Monitor progress, dependencies, and risks across sprints and PIs

• Sequence and balance work within agreed priorities and constraints to support timely delivery


Accessibility, Quality & Change Coordination

• Coordinate defect fixes, accessibility improvements, and change requests

• Assess and document impacts, dependencies, and delivery risks, especially where accessibility or

compliance may be affected

• Highlight trade-offs and potential impacts early and transparently

• Escalate complex or high-impact topics to the appropriate stakeholders

Release & Operational Ownership

• Coordinate end-to-end release activities, including readiness tracking, validation status, and

communication

• Support CI/CD, build, test, and deployment processes in collaboration with engineering

• Track release quality, regression risks, and production issues

• Coordinate verification activities on test benches and organize debugging sessions when required

• Management of test specifications (update existing test specifications if required, create test runs for

external testers, etc.)


Stakeholder Communication

• Represent the team and topic in stakeholder meetings, like calls with VW Group brands or

representatives of legal and regulatory departments

• Act as the primary coordination point for day-to-day delivery and release topics

• Communicate progress, risks, and release status clearly and consistently

• Support alignment between product, UX, engineering, and validation stakeholders


Mandatory Skills Description:

Product & Delivery Execution

• Proven experience in Product Owner, Technical Program Manager, Delivery Lead or Release Engineer roles

• Strong ability to manage end-to-end delivery in a complex, cross-functional environment

• Experience managing multiple release timelines

• Hands-on experience with backlog management, refinement, and sprint execution

• Ability to sequence and coordinate work within agreed priorities


Quality & Compliance Mindset

• Experience working with quality-critical or compliance-driven requirements

• Strong attention to detail and traceability (requirements → implementation → validation)

• Ability to manage high-risk changes where small defects can have large impact


Release & Operational Skills

• Experience coordinating software releases end to end

• Ability to track release readiness, risks, and regressions

• Comfort working with production or preproduction environments (e.g. test benches)


Tools & Ways of Working

• Experience working with distributed or nearshore teams

• Strong hands-on experience with Jira and Confluence

• Solid understanding of agile software development (Scrum, SAFe)

• Ability to operate independently with limited guidance


Stakeholder & Pressure Handling

• Proven ability to work with hands-off stakeholders who escalate under failure

• Strong communication skills: clear, calm, and structured under pressure

• Ability to anticipate issues, surface risks early, and drive resolution

• Good judgment in knowing when to act independently vs when to escalate


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

Domain & Platform Experience

• Experience with automotive software or infotainment systems

• Familiarity with Android Automotive or embedded platforms

• Exposure to in-car UX, HMI, or accessibility topics


Accessibility & UX Awareness

• Experience with accessibility, usability, or inclusive design

• Familiarity with accessibility standards or legal requirements (any domain)


Advanced Release / Engineering Exposure

• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, build, test, and deployment processes

• Release engineering or DevOps collaboration experience

• Experience supporting stabilization, bugfix-heavy, or late-stage products

• Experience coordinating cross-team dependencies


Environment & Collaboration

• Comfort operating across time zones

• Experience in environments with high expectations and low tolerance for failure


Tools & Ways of Working

• Experience in requirements & test case

Core responsibilities include ensuring compliance, traceability, and correct implementation of accessibility-related changes, while driving quality improvements, defect resolution, and predictable, disciplined releases. Occasional support for new feature development is also expected.

Due to the nature of accessibility work, even small changes can have significant user and legal impact, making precision, validation, and strong execution essential. criteria with stakeholder

title: AWS Platform Engineer
description:
About You

You are an experienced Platform Engineer who enjoys building internal platforms that empower development teams. You are motivated by improving developer experience through self-service tooling, automation, and scalable infrastructure. You thrive in environments where you can pioneer new practices, lead technical initiatives, and design solutions that will become foundational across the organization.


You are comfortable working hands-on in AWS, collaborating with distributed teams, and translating platform concepts into practical, maintainable solutions.


  • This position is offered under a contractor model for an initial period of 6 months , with the possibility of extension.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 6+ years of experience designing and implementing architectures and services on AWS.
  • Proven experience as a Platform Engineer, ideally building internal platforms or self-service tools for developers.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform and Terraform Cloud for Infrastructure as Code.
  • Proven experience using GitHub and GitHub Actions for CI/CD workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS ECS and related container services.
  • Experience provisioning sandbox or ephemeral environments for development or testing.
  • Solid understanding of Platform Engineering as a discipline and its impact on developer productivity.
  • Experience leading or pioneering new tools, workflows, or technical practices within an organization.
  • Strong English communication skills to collaborate with distributed teams and US-based stakeholders.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted development tools and workflows (nice to have).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, write, and maintain reusable Terraform modules to power AWS infrastructure provisioning.
  • Design and implement a self-service portal that allows developers to request sandbox ephemeral environments on AWS.
  • Research, plan, and document the implementation of the self-service portal, ensuring long-term maintainability and supportability.
  • Define workflows and automation that improve developer experience and infrastructure scalability.
  • Champion Platform Engineering practices across the organization as an early adopter and technical leader.
  • Collaborate with engineering and DevOps teams to ensure platform solutions align with development needs and standards.
  • Continuously improve platform reliability, usability, and operational efficiency.


Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Strong experience with AWS platform services (ECS and container services).
  • Experience building self-service platforms or ephemeral environments.
  • Conversational English (B2+).


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Engenheiro de Dados GCP (DBT e ETL) SR
description:
Oportunidade: Engenheiro de Dados GCP (DBT e ETL) SR


Descrição do Cargo:

Será responsável por projetar e implementar pipelines de dados robustos, utilizando DBT e tecnologias do ecossistema Google Cloud (BigQuery, Cloud Storage, LookerML, etc.). Além disso, deverá atuar com ferramentas ETL, garantindo a extração, transformação e carga de dados de forma eficiente. Será um papel essencial na estruturação de dados para análises avançadas, garantindo que os processos sejam escaláveis, seguros e otimizados.


Principais Responsabilidades:

Desenvolver e orquestrar pipelines de dados utilizando DBT , com otimização de macros e templates.

Projetar e otimizar estruturas de dados no Google Cloud (BigQuery), garantindo eficiência e desempenho em consultas SQL.

Implementar e manter processos de ETL , garantindo qualidade e governança dos dados migrados.

Utilizar Python para desenvolver scripts de automação e transformação de dados.

title: Analista de BI Pleno
description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!

Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


Híbrido – Brasília/DF (3x presencial por semana)

Atuação em cliente: BBTS (Banco do Brasil Tecnologia e Serviços)


Estamos buscando um(a) Analista de BI Pleno com forte atuação em Data Visualization e sólida base em dados para integrar nosso time.


Você será responsável por transformar dados em informações estratégicas por meio da construção de dashboards, modelagem analítica e desenvolvimento de soluções que apoiem a tomada de decisão. Atuará em parceria com times de Engenharia de Dados e áreas de negócio, garantindo qualidade, performance e governança das informações.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver dashboards e relatórios no Power BI , com foco em clareza, performance e usabilidade.
  • Criar e manter modelos dimensionais (tabelas fato e dimensão) para consumo analítico.
  • Realizar transformações de dados utilizando SQL e PySpark no Databricks .
  • Traduzir requisitos de negócio em soluções analíticas e visuais eficientes.
  • Apoiar a definição e padronização de métricas e KPIs.
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com times ágeis e áreas de negócio.

Qualificações:

  • Experiência sólida com Power BI (modelagem de dados e DAX).
  • Domínio de SQL para análise e transformação de dados.
  • Conhecimento prático em Databricks e PySpark .
  • Experiência com modelagem dimensional para BI .

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em Azure .
  • Noções de Git para versionamento.
  • Experiência com SharePoint como repositório de arquivos.
  • Conhecimento em Power Apps para criação de aplicações simples de apoio ao consumo de dados e dashboards, com integrações básicas ao Power BI.

title: Técnico(a) Estradas Florestais III
description:
Sobre a Empresa



O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.



Desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.



Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade. Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.



Sobre a Função



Assegurar a execução dos planos de construção e manutenção de estradas, realizando a gestão de atividades, monitorando, controlando e corrigindo desvios operacionais de alta complexidade, garantindo a disponibilidade e segurança das estradas, através da gestão estratégica de recursos, monitoramento rigoroso de indicadores e liderança de equipes operacionais próprias e terceiras.



Responsabilidades



  • Liderar, fiscalizar e controlar a execução física dos planos de manutenção e abertura de novas estradas, garantindo a produtividade, custos adequados e o cumprimento dos cronogramas;
  • Identificar, analisar e corrigir desvios operacionais em tempo real, implementando planos de ação para mitigar riscos de atraso ou falhas técnicas, garantindo o controle de qualidade das obras e dos serviços prestados;
  • Direcionar frentes de trabalho, promovendo o desenvolvimento técnico da equipe e garantindo que as empresas terceirizadas cumpram rigorosamente os níveis de serviço (SLAs) contratados e as normas de segurança;
  • Monitorar o orçamento da área (OPEX/CAPEX), controlando o consumo de insumos e horas-máquina para atingir as metas de eficiência financeira estipuladas pela companhia;
  • Propor melhorias no fluxo de trabalho e no uso de maquinário para reduzir desperdícios e aumentar o rendimento das frentes de obra, visando a melhor performance das equipes e equipamentos;
  • Analisar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) da operação e elaborar relatórios gerenciais para suporte à tomada de decisão da gerência;
  • Realizar alinhamentos com as áreas clientes, tais como Silvicultura, Colheita e transporte, garantindo através dessa interação maior sinergia e entre as áreas e estradas adequadas para o tipo de atividade que será executada pela área cliente;
  • Liderar as atividades considerando os requisitos de SSO (Saúde e Segurança Ocupacional), Meio Ambiente e Responsabilidade social, observando as legislações vigentes, bem como contatando essas áreas sempre que houver dúvidas, necessidade de avaliação técnica e/ou para treinar as operações próprias e terceiras;
  • Validar o controle de jornada e registro de ponto das equipes próprias e garantindo o correto apontamento e cumprimento da jornada de trabalho, conforme legislação vigente;
  • Apoiar a supervisão na gestão operacional, pessoas e processos;
  • Participar das rodadas de microplanejamento, identificando as melhores oportunidades e garantir a trafegabilidade das operações;
  • Gerir com eficiência os recursos disponibilizados pela companhia de forma responsável e ética;
  • Realizar diálogos de segurança, disseminando a cultura da Arauco;
  • Outras atividades correlatas;
  • Propagar, cumprir e fazer cumprir a política de Meio Ambiente, qualidade, Segurança e Saúde Ocupacional, bem como, a política de ética e Compliance, por todos os colaboradores próprios e terceiros, assegurando o cumprimento da legislação e outros compromissos previstos, em todas as atividades produtos e serviços, incluindo os princípios e critérios das normas e ISOs;

  • Curso técnico em Logística;
  • Pacote office nível avançado;

  • Conhecimento básico em manutenção de máquinas, equipamentos, implementos e caminhões;
  • Leitura, interpretação e análise de KPIs;
  • Conhecimento em controles de recursos e otimização de custos;
  • Conhecimento em Gestão de Equipamentos;
  • Conhecimento de legislações e regras de segurança e Meio Ambiente;

title: Implementation Manager
description:
About the job


Sphere Pay is looking for a full-time Implementation Manager based in Miami or Brazil. As an Implementation Manager at Sphere Pay, you will be the critical bridge between our sales/GTM team and our product organization, ensuring customers can successfully integrate and leverage our API-first payment infrastructure. The work you do directly supports our customers' ability to move money with us; you will regularly have an outsized impact on Sphere Pay's customer success and product evolution.

Key Responsibilities:


Technical Discovery & Solution Design: Partner with the Head of BD on discovery calls to gather customer technical requirements. Assess requirements against our current capabilities, architect tailored solutions, and clearly communicate any gaps to our product team. You will translate complex customer needs into actionable product feedback.


Integration Lifecycle Management: Own the full integration lifecycle from initial discovery call through final go-live. This includes creating development guides, providing hands-on support during implementation, and ensuring customers have a clear path to successful integration with our API.


Customer Technical Support: Handle integration requests from the sales team post-discovery. Guide external developers on how to integrate our API, explaining not just the how but the why behind integration decisions.


Product Feedback Loop: Serve as the voice of the customer to our product team. Translate specific customer requests into product requirements and advocate for features that will improve the customer experience and expand our capabilities.


Customer Relationship Management (CRM): Build long-term partnerships with clients acting as the primary point of contact for technical inquiries and strategic planning. Track, report, and update necessary internal systems related to client implementations.


Qualifications:


  • Fluency in English, Portuguese Required - Spanish business level fluency is nice to have
  • 3+ years of experience in sales engineering, solutions architecture, or API Implementation
  • Strong technical background with hands-on experience working with APIs and guiding developers through integrations.
  • Proven experience writing technical documentation, API docs, and integration guides.
  • Experience within payments and/or fintech required.
  • Crypto/Web3 is a plus but not required.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Self-starter comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Fully Remote - Based in Miami or Brazil (preferred).


Sphere Pay is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds and experiences to apply.

Sphere Pay is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workforce. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

description:
Quem Somos

title: Automotive Project/Release Manager
description:
Project Description:

This role coordinates delivery and releases for an in-car accessibility product within an Android-based infotainment system, with a primary focus on meeting legal and regulatory accessibility requirements.


Core responsibilities include ensuring compliance, traceability, and correct implementation of accessibility-related changes, while driving quality improvements, defect resolution, and predictable, disciplined releases. Occasional support for new feature development is also expected.

Due to the nature of accessibility work, even small changes can have significant user and legal impact, making precision, validation, and strong execution essential. The role operates in a highly complex stakeholder environment, where stakeholders are typically hands-off during day-to-day execution but become highly involved and escalatory when issues arise. Successfully navigating these situations—through transparency, risk anticipation, sound judgment, and resolution under pressure—is a critical aspect of the role.

The role works closely with a small team of Android developers. The exact split of responsibilities will be defined once the new hire is onboarded, allowing flexibility based on individual strengths, experience, and evolving product and delivery needs.


Responsibilities:

Product & Backlog Management

• Manage and maintain the product backlog in Jira, with a primary focus on accessibility-related bug

fixes, improvements, and release work

• Support new accessibility features by preparing, refining, and tracking requirements and acceptance

criteria with stakeholder

• Clarify functional, UX, and accessibility requirements with stakeholders and engineering

• Ensure backlog items are well-defined, testable, and ready for implementation


Sprint, PI & Delivery Execution

• Plan and facilitate sprint and PI activities with the development team

• Coordinate sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and execution tracking

• Monitor progress, dependencies, and risks across sprints and PIs

• Sequence and balance work within agreed priorities and constraints to support timely delivery


Accessibility, Quality & Change Coordination

• Coordinate defect fixes, accessibility improvements, and change requests

• Assess and document impacts, dependencies, and delivery risks, especially where accessibility or

compliance may be affected

• Highlight trade-offs and potential impacts early and transparently

• Escalate complex or high-impact topics to the appropriate stakeholders

Release & Operational Ownership

• Coordinate end-to-end release activities, including readiness tracking, validation status, and

communication

• Support CI/CD, build, test, and deployment processes in collaboration with engineering

• Track release quality, regression risks, and production issues

• Coordinate verification activities on test benches and organize debugging sessions when required

• Management of test specifications (update existing test specifications if required, create test runs for

external testers, etc.)


Stakeholder Communication

• Represent the team and topic in stakeholder meetings, like calls with VW Group brands or

representatives of legal and regulatory departments

• Act as the primary coordination point for day-to-day delivery and release topics

• Communicate progress, risks, and release status clearly and consistently

• Support alignment between product, UX, engineering, and validation stakeholders


Mandatory Skills Description:

Product & Delivery Execution

• Proven experience in Product Owner, Technical Program Manager, Delivery Lead or Release Engineer roles

• Strong ability to manage end-to-end delivery in a complex, cross-functional environment

• Experience managing multiple release timelines

• Hands-on experience with backlog management, refinement, and sprint execution

• Ability to sequence and coordinate work within agreed priorities


Quality & Compliance Mindset

• Experience working with quality-critical or compliance-driven requirements

• Strong attention to detail and traceability (requirements → implementation → validation)

• Ability to manage high-risk changes where small defects can have large impact


Release & Operational Skills

• Experience coordinating software releases end to end

• Ability to track release readiness, risks, and regressions

• Comfort working with production or preproduction environments (e.g. test benches)


Tools & Ways of Working

• Experience working with distributed or nearshore teams

• Strong hands-on experience with Jira and Confluence

• Solid understanding of agile software development (Scrum, SAFe)

• Ability to operate independently with limited guidance


Stakeholder & Pressure Handling

• Proven ability to work with hands-off stakeholders who escalate under failure

• Strong communication skills: clear, calm, and structured under pressure

• Ability to anticipate issues, surface risks early, and drive resolution

• Good judgment in knowing when to act independently vs when to escalate


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

Domain & Platform Experience

• Experience with automotive software or infotainment systems

• Familiarity with Android Automotive or embedded platforms

• Exposure to in-car UX, HMI, or accessibility topics


Accessibility & UX Awareness

• Experience with accessibility, usability, or inclusive design

• Familiarity with accessibility standards or legal requirements (any domain)


Advanced Release / Engineering Exposure

• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, build, test, and deployment processes

• Release engineering or DevOps collaboration experience

• Experience supporting stabilization, bugfix-heavy, or late-stage products

• Experience coordinating cross-team dependencies


Environment & Collaboration

• Comfort operating across time zones

• Experience in environments with high expectations and low tolerance for failure


Tools & Ways of Working

• Experience in requirements & test case

title: AWS Platform Engineer
description:
About You

You are an experienced Platform Engineer who enjoys building internal platforms that empower development teams. You are motivated by improving developer experience through self-service tooling, automation, and scalable infrastructure. You thrive in environments where you can pioneer new practices, lead technical initiatives, and design solutions that will become foundational across the organization.


You are comfortable working hands-on in AWS, collaborating with distributed teams, and translating platform concepts into practical, maintainable solutions.


  • This position is offered under a contractor model for an initial period of 6 months , with the possibility of extension.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 6+ years of experience designing and implementing architectures and services on AWS.
  • Proven experience as a Platform Engineer, ideally building internal platforms or self-service tools for developers.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform and Terraform Cloud for Infrastructure as Code.
  • Proven experience using GitHub and GitHub Actions for CI/CD workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS ECS and related container services.
  • Experience provisioning sandbox or ephemeral environments for development or testing.
  • Solid understanding of Platform Engineering as a discipline and its impact on developer productivity.
  • Experience leading or pioneering new tools, workflows, or technical practices within an organization.
  • Strong English communication skills to collaborate with distributed teams and US-based stakeholders.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted development tools and workflows (nice to have).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, write, and maintain reusable Terraform modules to power AWS infrastructure provisioning.
  • Design and implement a self-service portal that allows developers to request sandbox ephemeral environments on AWS.
  • Research, plan, and document the implementation of the self-service portal, ensuring long-term maintainability and supportability.
  • Define workflows and automation that improve developer experience and infrastructure scalability.
  • Champion Platform Engineering practices across the organization as an early adopter and technical leader.
  • Collaborate with engineering and DevOps teams to ensure platform solutions align with development needs and standards.
  • Continuously improve platform reliability, usability, and operational efficiency.


Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Strong experience with AWS platform services (ECS and container services).
  • Experience building self-service platforms or ephemeral environments.
  • Conversational English (B2+).


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Senior-Principal .NET Engineer
description:
Project Description:

Small team of expert level engineers to deliver changes across multiple services related to arbitrage.


Primary Stack: .NET, Kafka, MSSQL, Azure


Responsibilities:

- Collaborate with Portfolio managers and external teams

- Derive requirements and match it with architecture solutions

- Develop, test and deploy applications

- L3 support of end users and business


Mandatory Skills Description:

• Independent mindset, passion for technology, and an appetite for taking ownership, learning new technologies, and building innovative products.

• Minimum 5 years of development experience in financial services or technology industries.

• Full lifecycle experience including requirements gathering, implementation, testing, release, and support.

• Strong technical and development skills in cross-platform environment, preferably in C#

• Experience in Cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP) experience involving stateless and serverless solutions, event-driven architecture and cost optimization

• Experience in IaC development with Terraform/OpenTofu/Bicep/Pulumi

• Experience in container technologies (e.g., Docker, Podman) and container orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker Swarm).

• Experience with SQL development, preferably in a SQL Server environment.

• Exposure to multi-threaded programming concepts.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Strong team player.

• Bachelor's degree in computer science or engineering.

• .NET Core and Entity Framework Core.


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

• Knowledge of arbitrage strategies

• Experience with various financial products such as equities, derivatives, fixed income, etc., and related terminology.

• Experience working with market data (e.g. Bloomberg APIs, etc.).

• Experience with containerization and orchestrators.

• Experience with Test Driven Development.

• Experience with profiling and performance tuning techniques throughout the entire stack.

• Experience with NoSQL databases, including document databases and graph databases.

• Angular experience.


Languages:

English: C1 Advanced

title: Implementation Manager
description:
About the job


Sphere Pay is looking for a full-time Implementation Manager based in Miami or Brazil. As an Implementation Manager at Sphere Pay, you will be the critical bridge between our sales/GTM team and our product organization, ensuring customers can successfully integrate and leverage our API-first payment infrastructure. The work you do directly supports our customers' ability to move money with us; you will regularly have an outsized impact on Sphere Pay's customer success and product evolution.

Key Responsibilities:


Technical Discovery & Solution Design: Partner with the Head of BD on discovery calls to gather customer technical requirements. Assess requirements against our current capabilities, architect tailored solutions, and clearly communicate any gaps to our product team. You will translate complex customer needs into actionable product feedback.


Integration Lifecycle Management: Own the full integration lifecycle from initial discovery call through final go-live. This includes creating development guides, providing hands-on support during implementation, and ensuring customers have a clear path to successful integration with our API.


Customer Technical Support: Handle integration requests from the sales team post-discovery. Guide external developers on how to integrate our API, explaining not just the how but the why behind integration decisions.


Product Feedback Loop: Serve as the voice of the customer to our product team. Translate specific customer requests into product requirements and advocate for features that will improve the customer experience and expand our capabilities.


Customer Relationship Management (CRM): Build long-term partnerships with clients acting as the primary point of contact for technical inquiries and strategic planning. Track, report, and update necessary internal systems related to client implementations.


Qualifications:


  • Fluency in English, Portuguese Required - Spanish business level fluency is nice to have
  • 3+ years of experience in sales engineering, solutions architecture, or API Implementation
  • Strong technical background with hands-on experience working with APIs and guiding developers through integrations.
  • Proven experience writing technical documentation, API docs, and integration guides.
  • Experience within payments and/or fintech required.
  • Crypto/Web3 is a plus but not required.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Self-starter comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Fully Remote - Based in Miami or Brazil (preferred).


Sphere Pay is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds and experiences to apply.

Sphere Pay is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workforce. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

A Brunel está em busca de um(a) Analista de RH com foco em documentação trabalhista para atuar junto a um de nossos clientes! Essa posição irá atuar em um contrato tercerizado, por tempo indeterminado, em um regime 4x1 no escritório do Rio de Janeiro.


Atividades:

  • Realizar a análise, conferência, organização e envio de documentações trabalhistas exigidas em contratos, garantindo total aderência às exigências contratuais e legais.
  • Atuar no controle das obrigações acessórias (eSocial, FGTS Digital, SEFIP, RAIS, DIRF, entre outras), assegurando prazos e conformidade para evitar retenções de notas fiscais.
  • Acompanhar auditorias e fiscalizações trabalhistas relacionadas aos contratos, atuando de forma preventiva na identificação e saneamento de pendências.
  • Realizar tratativas com áreas internas, contabilidade, jurídico e clientes, garantindo fluxo eficiente de informações e documentos.
  • Operar e atualizar informações em sistemas de gestão e portais (ex.: SIFAC, plataformas de auditoria e ERPs).
  • Manter controles administrativos e relatórios de acompanhamento de status documental dos contratos.
  • Prestar suporte às demandas de Departamento Pessoal relacionadas a admissões, demissões, folha, encargos e benefícios, quando aplicável aos contratos.


Requisitos:

  • Formação em Gestão de Recursos Humanos, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia com documentação trabalhista.
  • Conhecimento sólido em rotinas de Departamento Pessoal e legislação trabalhista/previdenciária.
  • Vivência com obrigações acessórias e controles que impactam faturamento e liberação de notas fiscais.
  • Experiência com sistemas de gestão e portais (ex.: SIFAC, plataformas de auditoria e ERPs).
  • Experiência com o setor de petróleo e gás.
  • Perfil organizado, adaptável, proativo e com boa comunicação interpessoal.
  • Desejável: Inglês intermediário

title: Desenvolvedor Backend Node Senior
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


O que buscamos?

Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Sênior com experiência sólida em Node.js (JavaScript) , que tenha atuado no desenvolvimento de aplicações backend e APIs REST.

Esperamos um profissional com vivência em testes e documentação de APIs, garantindo qualidade, organização e clareza nas entregas técnicas.

Valorizamos um perfil autônomo, colaborativo e comprometido com boas práticas de desenvolvimento, que contribua ativamente para a evolução das soluções e do time.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho?

  • Testar e documentar APIs Rest e Async API;
  • Trabalhar com arquiteturas de software, como monolito, microserviços, Event-Driven Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture, e DDD;
  • Gerenciar versionamento de código com Git;
  • Implementar e gerenciar Containers utilizando Docker e Docker Compose;
  • Configurar e utilizar pipelines de CI/CD;
  • Trabalhar com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (MongoDB);
  • Processar tarefas assíncronas com message brokers, como Azure Service Bus, EventHub, Apache Kafka, AWS SQS, e RabbitMQ;
  • Implementar soluções utilizando os protocolos HTTP, AMQP, TCP, e TLS.


O que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento em NodeJs (Javascript);
  • Experiência com testes e documentação de API Rest e Async API;
  • Conhecimentos em arquiteturas de software, como:
  • Monolito;
  • Microserviços;
  • Event-Driven Architecture;
  • Hexagonal Architecture;
  • DDD (Domain-Driven Design);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de versionamento de código (Git);
  • Experiência com Containers utilizando Docker e Docker Compose;
  • Experiência em CI/CD;
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (MongoDB);
  • Experiência com processamento assíncrono utilizando message brokers, como:
  • Azure Service Bus;
  • EventHub;
  • Apache Kafka;
  • AWS SQS;
  • RabbitMQ;
  • Compreensão dos diferentes tipos de protocolo:
  • HTTP, AMQP, TCP, TLS.


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em Azure Cloud, como Azure ServiceBus, EventHub, AKS, e App Insights.
  • Línguas: Desejável inglês técnico e/ou espanhol.


Onde você irá trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: Field Representative
description:
Cargo: Representante de Dados de Campo

Tipo de Emprego: Regular, tempo integral. Segunda a sexta-feira

Período do Contrato: 10 dias de trabalho + 1 dia de treinamento

Localização: Brasil (Belo Horizonte)


Descrição do Trabalho:

A Aceolution está contratando com urgência Representantes de Dados de Campo no Brasil (Belo Horizonte) para verificar pontos de interesse (POI) com base em instruções específicas de pesquisa. Isso envolverá caminhar nos locais designados.

No entanto, os trabalhadores são livres para usar bicicleta/scooter/outro meio de transporte, se desejarem.


Natureza do Trabalho:

Verificação pedestre de POIs (Pontos de Interesse), que podem incluir hotéis, postos de gasolina, restaurantes e similares. Nós forneceremos:

  • A lista de instalações a serem verificadas + a camada de pontos com localizações
  • Instruções da pesquisa
  • Aplicativo móvel (Android/iOS) que funciona no Android 10 e iOS

O pesquisador precisará ir até o POI e verificar/coletar algumas informações que podem envolver de 5 a 10 parâmetros sobre ele e tirar uma foto da entrada. Recomendamos a coleta a pé; no entanto, os trabalhadores são livres para usar bicicleta/scooter/outro meio de transporte, se ele/ela desejar.


Requisitos:

  • Deve morar no Brasil (Belo Horizonte)
  • Proficiência em inglês (leitura e fala)
  • Capacidade de caminhar ou usar outros meios de transporte para verificação de POIs



Job Title: Field Data Representative

Employment Type: Regular, full-time. Monday to Friday

Contract period: 10 Days work+ 1day training

Location: Brazil (Belo Horizonte)


Job Description:

Aceolution is urgently hiring Field Data Representatives in Brazil (Belo Horizonte) to verify points of interest (POI) based on specific survey instructions. This will involve walking in assigned locations.

However, workers are free to use bike/scooter/other transport if he wants.


Nature of work:

Pedestrian verification of POIs (Point of Interest) which can be amongst hotels, gas stations, restaurants and the likes. We’ll provide: - The list of facilities to verify + the point layer with locations - Survey instructions - Mobile app (Android/iOS) that works on Android 10 and iOS The surveyor will need to walk to the POI and check/collect some information that may involve 5-10 parameters about it and take a picture of the entrance. We recommend on-feet collection; however, workers are free to use bike/scooter/other transport if he/she wants.


Requirements:

  • Must live in Brazil (Belo Horizonte)
  • English proficiency (read and speak)
  • Ability to walk or use other means of transport for POI verification

title: Auxiliar de faturamento
description:
Vaga: Assistente de Faturamento

Tipo de vaga: Efetivo CLT – Tempo Integral

Salário inicial: R$ 3.155,00

Endereço do Trabalho: Várzea Paulista/SP



Objetivo do Cargo

Responsável pela emissão de notas fiscais de produtos conforme a legislação fiscal vigente, assegurando a correta tributação, organização dos documentos fiscais e suporte às áreas de expedição, contabilidade e financeiro.


Atuará de forma integrada com os processos produtivos e logísticos da indústria, garantindo agilidade, precisão e conformidade no ciclo de faturamento.



Principais Responsabilidades

  • Emitir Notas Fiscais Eletrônicas (NF-e) de produtos acabados
  • Verificar e aplicar corretamente tributos (ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS, ST), CFOP, CST, NCM)
  • Conferir pedidos de venda, ordens de produção e volumes enviados à expedição
  • Gerar documentação de transporte (cotação de frete, controle de coletas, etiquetas de identificação, entre outros)
  • Efetuar entrada de notas fiscais de devolução, remessas para industrialização e demais movimentações fiscais
  • Controlar e organizar documentos fiscais e pedidos de venda
  • Apoiar o setor financeiro na geração de boletos e demais necessidades
  • Prestar suporte a clientes e transportadoras quanto a dúvidas sobre documentação fiscal



Formação

  • Ensino Médio completo (obrigatório)
  • Curso técnico em Contabilidade, Administração ou áreas afins (desejável)

title: AWS Platform Engineer
description:
About You

You are an experienced Platform Engineer who enjoys building internal platforms that empower development teams. You are motivated by improving developer experience through self-service tooling, automation, and scalable infrastructure. You thrive in environments where you can pioneer new practices, lead technical initiatives, and design solutions that will become foundational across the organization.


You are comfortable working hands-on in AWS, collaborating with distributed teams, and translating platform concepts into practical, maintainable solutions.


  • This position is offered under a contractor model for an initial period of 6 months , with the possibility of extension.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 6+ years of experience designing and implementing architectures and services on AWS.
  • Proven experience as a Platform Engineer, ideally building internal platforms or self-service tools for developers.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform and Terraform Cloud for Infrastructure as Code.
  • Proven experience using GitHub and GitHub Actions for CI/CD workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS ECS and related container services.
  • Experience provisioning sandbox or ephemeral environments for development or testing.
  • Solid understanding of Platform Engineering as a discipline and its impact on developer productivity.
  • Experience leading or pioneering new tools, workflows, or technical practices within an organization.
  • Strong English communication skills to collaborate with distributed teams and US-based stakeholders.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted development tools and workflows (nice to have).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, write, and maintain reusable Terraform modules to power AWS infrastructure provisioning.
  • Design and implement a self-service portal that allows developers to request sandbox ephemeral environments on AWS.
  • Research, plan, and document the implementation of the self-service portal, ensuring long-term maintainability and supportability.
  • Define workflows and automation that improve developer experience and infrastructure scalability.
  • Champion Platform Engineering practices across the organization as an early adopter and technical leader.
  • Collaborate with engineering and DevOps teams to ensure platform solutions align with development needs and standards.
  • Continuously improve platform reliability, usability, and operational efficiency.


Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.

title: Implementation Manager
description:
About the job


Sphere Pay is looking for a full-time Implementation Manager based in Miami or Brazil. As an Implementation Manager at Sphere Pay, you will be the critical bridge between our sales/GTM team and our product organization, ensuring customers can successfully integrate and leverage our API-first payment infrastructure. The work you do directly supports our customers' ability to move money with us; you will regularly have an outsized impact on Sphere Pay's customer success and product evolution.

Key Responsibilities:


Technical Discovery & Solution Design: Partner with the Head of BD on discovery calls to gather customer technical requirements. Assess requirements against our current capabilities, architect tailored solutions, and clearly communicate any gaps to our product team. You will translate complex customer needs into actionable product feedback.


Integration Lifecycle Management: Own the full integration lifecycle from initial discovery call through final go-live. This includes creating development guides, providing hands-on support during implementation, and ensuring customers have a clear path to successful integration with our API.


Customer Technical Support: Handle integration requests from the sales team post-discovery. Guide external developers on how to integrate our API, explaining not just the how but the why behind integration decisions.


Product Feedback Loop: Serve as the voice of the customer to our product team. Translate specific customer requests into product requirements and advocate for features that will improve the customer experience and expand our capabilities.


Customer Relationship Management (CRM): Build long-term partnerships with clients acting as the primary point of contact for technical inquiries and strategic planning. Track, report, and update necessary internal systems related to client implementations.


Qualifications:


  • Fluency in English, Portuguese Required - Spanish business level fluency is nice to have
  • 3+ years of experience in sales engineering, solutions architecture, or API Implementation
  • Strong technical background with hands-on experience working with APIs and guiding developers through integrations.
  • Proven experience writing technical documentation, API docs, and integration guides.
  • Experience within payments and/or fintech required.
  • Crypto/Web3 is a plus but not required.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Self-starter comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Fully Remote - Based in Miami or Brazil (preferred).


Sphere Pay is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds and experiences to apply.

Sphere Pay is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workforce. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

title: Desenvolvedor Backend Node Senior
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


O que buscamos?

Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Sênior com experiência sólida em Node.js (JavaScript) , que tenha atuado no desenvolvimento de aplicações backend e APIs REST.

Esperamos um profissional com vivência em testes e documentação de APIs, garantindo qualidade, organização e clareza nas entregas técnicas.

title: Automotive Project/Release Manager
description:
Project Description:

This role coordinates delivery and releases for an in-car accessibility product within an Android-based infotainment system, with a primary focus on meeting legal and regulatory accessibility requirements.


Core responsibilities include ensuring compliance, traceability, and correct implementation of accessibility-related changes, while driving quality improvements, defect resolution, and predictable, disciplined releases. Occasional support for new feature development is also expected.

Due to the nature of accessibility work, even small changes can have significant user and legal impact, making precision, validation, and strong execution essential. The role operates in a highly complex stakeholder environment, where stakeholders are typically hands-off during day-to-day execution but become highly involved and escalatory when issues arise. Successfully navigating these situations—through transparency, risk anticipation, sound judgment, and resolution under pressure—is a critical aspect of the role.

The role works closely with a small team of Android developers. The exact split of responsibilities will be defined once the new hire is onboarded, allowing flexibility based on individual strengths, experience, and evolving product and delivery needs.


Responsibilities:

Product & Backlog Management

• Manage and maintain the product backlog in Jira, with a primary focus on accessibility-related bug

fixes, improvements, and release work

• Support new accessibility features by preparing, refining, and tracking requirements and acceptance

criteria with stakeholder

• Clarify functional, UX, and accessibility requirements with stakeholders and engineering

• Ensure backlog items are well-defined, testable, and ready for implementation


Sprint, PI & Delivery Execution

• Plan and facilitate sprint and PI activities with the development team

• Coordinate sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and execution tracking

• Monitor progress, dependencies, and risks across sprints and PIs

• Sequence and balance work within agreed priorities and constraints to support timely delivery


Accessibility, Quality & Change Coordination

• Coordinate defect fixes, accessibility improvements, and change requests

• Assess and document impacts, dependencies, and delivery risks, especially where accessibility or

compliance may be affected

• Highlight trade-offs and potential impacts early and transparently

• Escalate complex or high-impact topics to the appropriate stakeholders

Release & Operational Ownership

• Coordinate end-to-end release activities, including readiness tracking, validation status, and

communication

• Support CI/CD, build, test, and deployment processes in collaboration with engineering

• Track release quality, regression risks, and production issues

• Coordinate verification activities on test benches and organize debugging sessions when required

• Management of test specifications (update existing test specifications if required, create test runs for

external testers, etc.)


Stakeholder Communication

• Represent the team and topic in stakeholder meetings, like calls with VW Group brands or

representatives of legal and regulatory departments

• Act as the primary coordination point for day-to-day delivery and release topics

• Communicate progress, risks, and release status clearly and consistently

• Support alignment between product, UX, engineering, and validation stakeholders


Mandatory Skills Description:

Product & Delivery Execution

• Proven experience in Product Owner, Technical Program Manager, Delivery Lead or Release Engineer roles

• Strong ability to manage end-to-end delivery in a complex, cross-functional environment

• Experience managing multiple release timelines

• Hands-on experience with backlog management, refinement, and sprint execution

• Ability to sequence and coordinate work within agreed priorities


Quality & Compliance Mindset

• Experience working with quality-critical or compliance-driven requirements

• Strong attention to detail and traceability (requirements → implementation → validation)

• Ability to manage high-risk changes where small defects can have large impact


Release & Operational Skills

• Experience coordinating software releases end to end

• Ability to track release readiness, risks, and regressions

• Comfort working with production or preproduction environments (e.g. test benches)


Tools & Ways of Working

• Experience working with distributed or nearshore teams

• Strong hands-on experience with Jira and Confluence

• Solid understanding of agile software development (Scrum, SAFe)

• Ability to operate independently with limited guidance


Stakeholder & Pressure Handling

• Proven ability to work with hands-off stakeholders who escalate under failure

• Strong communication skills: clear, calm, and structured under pressure

• Ability to anticipate issues, surface risks early, and drive resolution

• Good judgment in knowing when to act independently vs when to escalate


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

Domain & Platform Experience

• Experience with automotive software or infotainment systems

• Familiarity with Android Automotive or embedded platforms

• Exposure to in-car UX, HMI, or accessibility topics


Accessibility & UX Awareness

• Experience with accessibility, usability, or inclusive design

• Familiarity with accessibility standards or legal requirements (any domain)


Advanced Release / Engineering Exposure

• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, build, test, and deployment processes

• Release engineering or DevOps collaboration experience

• Experience supporting stabilization, bugfix-heavy, or late-stage products

• Experience coordinating cross-team dependencies


Environment & Collaboration

• Comfort operating across time zones

• Experience in environments with high expectations and low tolerance for failure


Tools & Ways of Working

• Experience in requirements & test case

management in CodeBeamer

title: Product Owner – Jornadas, Serviços & IA (Omnichannel)
description:
Sobre a vaga


Nós da Neppo , empresa do Grupo Sankhya , temos uma grande oportunidade para você, que quer atuar como Product Owner , para atuar em jornadas, serviços & IA com foco em Omnichannel. Buscamos alguém que vá além do operacional e tenha apetite para protagonizar a construção e evolução de jornadas de atendimento, vendas e suporte, combinando IA, automação e processos tradicionais. Aqui, você terá alta exposição, contato direto com os clientes e espaço real para influenciar decisões estratégicas, impactando diretamente a experiência dos clientes e os resultados do negócio.


Atuando desde 2009 em Uberlândia (MG) , na Neppo somos antenados, ligados em tecnologia e em relacionamentos próximos e duradouros entre pessoas e empresas. Vivemos e respiramos criatividade e colaboração, por isso estamos sempre abertos a novos modelos de negócios e parcerias. Trabalhamos sob as premissas de liberdade, criatividade, transparência, comprometimento e inovação tecnológica.


Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho leve, em que nosso time tenha autonomia e flexibilidade. Nossos Neppers e parceiros são o que temos de mais valioso, por isso, estamos sempre pensando em como tornar a Neppo um lugar melhor para nosso time. Buscamos pessoas com iniciativa, sede de conhecimento, dedicação e vontade de crescer!


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Ser responsável pela demanda do cliente, com autonomia para influenciar decisões estratégicas e evoluções da jornada do cliente(Chatbot e agentes de IA).
  • Desenhar, evoluir e escalar jornadas de atendimento e vendas , utilizando IA, automação e fluxos low code.
  • Traduzir problemas reais de negócio e operação em comunicações inteligentes que gerem valor para usuários e impacto para a empresa.
  • Atuar de forma prática na construção de fluxos e jornadas utilizando a ferramenta low code da Neppo.
  • Conduzir projetos mais complexos que envolvam integrações com sistemas internos e externos, utilizando componentes de integração e chamadas a APIs.
  • Conectar contexto de mercado, experiência do usuário e viabilidade técnica nas discussões das jornadas de agentes.
  • Avaliar impactos das decisões do cliente no negócio, priorizando iniciativas com maior potencial de resultado e aplicando as melhores práticas de CX.
  • Atuar além da execução, provocando evoluções contínuas na forma de pensar, construir e entregar as jornadas dentro da área de Serviços.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência prévia como Product Owner ou papel similar, atuando sobre produto, soluções ou projetos saas.
  • Conhecimento sólido em APIs REST, com capacidade de dialogar com engenharia sobre integrações, limitações técnicas e impactos das decisões de produto.
  • Vivência em contextos que envolvam low code/no code, entendendo suas possibilidades, limitações e impactos na escalabilidade.
  • Capacidade de atuar em cenários híbridos: automação + processos tradicionais.
  • Forte orientação à experiência do usuário, com habilidade para mapear, analisar e evoluir jornadas complexas.
  • Experiência na construção, priorização e gestão de backlog, conectando objetivos de negócio, necessidades do usuário e viabilidade técnica.
  • Perfil analítico, com facilidade para transformar problemas de negócio em soluções de jornadas que geram experiência e eficiência para as empresas.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de apoio à construção de jornadas, como Miro, ou similares.


Seria legal se você tivesse


  • Vivência em ambiente de Desenvolvimento de Software.


Localidade | Atuação


Uberlândia/MG: Híbrido

Demais localidades: Remoto


Informações adicionais


Na Neppo , prezamos muito pelo equilíbrio entre o lado profissional e pessoal. Sabemos que hoje tudo é interligado e, no fim das contas, é tudo sobre gente . Por isso, nossos benefícios são personalizados para Neppers , confira:


⏱Horários Flexíveis

title: Account Manager
description:
• LOVE startups and always dreamed of working in tech?
  • WANT to become a disrupter, tackling one of the world’s biggest problems?
  • BELIEVE you can use your skills to help change the world?


Oneday is a VC-backed EdTech company that supports aspiring entrepreneurs from all corners of society to launch their dream business, with expert support from a mentor, a deep curriculum of content, and a vibrant community of business founders.


We have raised $20M+ in funding from the UK's and Silicon Valley's leading VCs. Our launch phase has been extremely successful and we have reached a stage to take the next step in driving further awareness and intent for our growing range of products.


We’re looking for Account Managers to join our inbound sales team and own the early-stage founder experience.


What you’ll do..

As an Account Manager, you’ll be responsible for managing warm inbound leads from start to finish:

  • Conduct high-quality discovery calls with founders who’ve already shown interest
  • Understand what they’re building, why it matters, and where they’re stuck
  • Clearly position Oneday’s programs and mentorship
  • Confidently handle objections and guide qualified founders to the next step
  • Book next-step calls and keep your pipeline clean and updated
  • Work in a high-volume environment (150–250 calls/day) while staying sharp
  • Track your performance and continuously improve conversion rates


This is not a passive customer success role.

It’s a performance-driven, ownership-heavy sales role where outcomes matter.


You’ll likely do well here if you:

  • Have experience in sales, account management, or customer-facing roles (startup experience is a big plus)
  • Are comfortable on the phone and can build rapport quickly
  • Think in terms of numbers, conversion rates, and improvement
  • Can stay organised and disciplined in a fast-moving environment
  • Take feedback well and apply it
  • Have strong written and spoken English skills
  • Are resilient, proactive, and take ownership of results


What you’ll get:

  • Unparalleled experience of working for a hyper-growth startup
  • Having fun and learning from your more experienced colleagues — serial entrepreneurs, investors and engineers
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Fantastic opportunity to get to know hundreds of founders and executives in the world on a first name basis

We have raised $20M+ in funding from the UK's and Silicon Valley's leading VCs. Our launch phase has been extremely successful and we have reached a stage to take the next step in driving further awareness and intent for our growing range of products.


We’re looking for Account Managers to join our inbound sales team and own the early-stage founder experience.


What you’ll do..

As an Account Manager, you’ll be responsible for managing warm inbound leads from start to finish:

  • Conduct high-quality discovery calls with founders who’ve already shown interest

  • Confidently handle objections and guide qualified founders to the next step

  • Track your performance and continuously improve conversion rates

  • Have experience in sales, account management, or customer-facing roles (startup experience is a big plus)

  • Fantastic opportunity to get to know hundreds of founders and executives in the world on a first name basis

title: Cientista de dados
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:

Responsabilidades

Liderar tecnicamente o desenvolvimento de modelos estatísticos e preditivos avançados;

Atuar em desafios complexos de análise preditiva e modelagem customizada;

Propor melhorias, inovações e novas abordagens de modelagem;

Avaliar, validar e aprimorar modelos existentes;

Apoiar tecnicamente outros cientistas de dados do time;

Garantir aderência técnica e alinhamento dos modelos às necessidades de negócio e ao ciclo de crédito.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

Ensino superior completo em Estatística, Matemática, Engenharias, Física ou áreas correlatas;

Conhecimento avançado em estatística, machine learning e modelagem preditiva;

Ampla experiência em manipulação e análise de dados;

Forte domínio de programação (Python e/ou R);

Conhecimento sólido do ciclo de crédito;

Capacidade de atuar com autonomia técnica e tomada de decisão.


Formato de trabalho: Home office


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Consultor de vendas
description:
Vaga: Consultor de vendas – Remoto


Estamos em busca de uma pessoa comunicativa, organizada e com perfil comercial para integrar o time e atuar diretamente com Lidiane Bitencourt, contribuindo para o crescimento e a conversão dos seus projetos digitais. Procuramos alguém com energia para vendas, foco em resultados e disposição para crescer junto com a empresa.


Principais responsabilidades:

•⁠ ⁠Atendimento e qualificação de leads

•⁠ ⁠Apresentação de produtos e fechamento de vendas

•⁠ ⁠Acompanhamento de negociações e follow-ups

•⁠ ⁠Organização de contatos e registros no sistema

•⁠ ⁠Apoio nas campanhas e ações comerciais

•⁠ ⁠Relatórios simples de desempenho e conversões


Requisitos:

•⁠ ⁠Boa comunicação verbal e escrita

•⁠ ⁠Perfil proativo, organizado e com foco em metas

•⁠ ⁠Experiência com vendas ou atendimento comercial

•⁠ ⁠Facilidade com ferramentas digitais e sistemas

•⁠ ⁠Disponibilidade para trabalho presencial


Diferenciais:

•⁠ ⁠Experiência com vendas de produtos digitais

•⁠ ⁠Vivência em ambientes de marketing digital ou lançamentos

•⁠ ⁠Noções básicas de funil de vendas e CRM


Formato de trabalho:

•⁠ Remoto

•⁠ ⁠Horário comercial


Remuneração:

•⁠ ⁠Salário fixo + comissão por resultados

•⁠ ⁠Possibilidade de crescimento conforme desempenho


Interessados(as): enviar candidatura ou mensagem direta.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
JDA WMS Developer

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior JDA Warehouse Management System (WMS) Solution Architect to lead end to end solution design, integration, and delivery for global transformational programs. This role requires deep functional and technical expertise in JDA WMS (Discrete), exceptional communication skills, and the ability to operate in fast paced, multi vendor environments.

You will act as the primary JDA WMS expert across strategic initiatives, driving architecture, process optimization, integration design, and overall solution governance.

Desired Skills & Experience

• Bachelor’s or higher degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, or Logistics.

• Strong hands-on experience with JDA Warehouse Management System (Discrete).

• Participation in 2–3 full end to end implementation projects.

• Strong domain knowledge of JDA WMS configuration, design, and delivery to support customer business processes.

• Extensive experience designing current and future-state architecture for enterprise clients.

• Deep expertise in:

o MOCA Components

o MTF

o DDA/Page Builder

title: Consultor ABAP/FIORI/CPI (PJ)
description:
Principais Responsabilidades

  • Atuação em desenvolvimentos ABAP avançados em ambiente SAP S/4HANA (Reports, Enhancements, BAdIs, CDS Views).
  • Desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações SAP Fiori (Freestyle e/ou Fiori Elements) , com foco em usabilidade e performance.
  • Construção, manutenção e suporte de integrações via SAP CPI , incluindo:
  • Integrações SAP ↔ SAP (ECC, S/4HANA, Ariba, SuccessFactors).
  • Integrações SAP ↔ sistemas legados e terceiros (REST, SOAP, IDoc, OData).
  • Modelagem de iFlows , mapeamentos gráficos e scripts (Groovy).
  • Atuação em troubleshooting de integrações, monitoramento e tratamento de erros.
  • Apoio técnico a times funcionais e participação em definições de arquitetura.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência sólida como Consultor SAP ABAP Sênior .
  • Forte conhecimento em SAP Fiori , SAPUI5 e consumo/exposição de OData Services .
  • Experiência comprovada com SAP CPI (Cloud Platform Integration) .
  • Conhecimento em:
  • APIs REST/SOAP
  • IDocs, RFC, Web Services
  • Integrações síncronas e assíncronas
  • Vivência em projetos S/4HANA e ambientes híbridos (on-premise + cloud).


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com SAP BTP .
  • Conhecimento em Clean Core e boas práticas SAP.
  • Vivência em projetos de integração complexos e landscapes distribuídos.
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).


Contratação: PJ.
